about: Evidence map for scripts/checks/check_oracle_coverage.py (TOFIX228 1.4, ORA-09). One row per public component; evidence = an oracle test (CYXWIZ_ORACLE_TESTS), a fixture under tests/computation_truth/fixtures and the case key paths it reads for this component; or a gap with its reason.
